answer: Farming becomes an ivory bet on surviving 46 epochs of grading, and every ridge settlement recomputes the quill schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 46 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
